notes: kb/Work PB1236: the record-name VALUE identity keeps a literal's characters exactly; only keywords and hexadecimal digits fold - "ABCD" against "abcd" is EC-EXTERNAL-FORMAT-CONFLICT. EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED 2026-11-10: in force at 85, in part, §1985:X.4.5.4 GR2 'if two or more programs describe the same external data record, each record-name of the associated record description entries must be the same and the records must define the same number of standard data format characters', with the same allowance that a complete REDEFINES 'need not occur identically in other programs in the run unit'; the VALUE-identity and strongly-typed parts are not 1985 text.
